definitions.explanation: The opening in a lock into which a key is inserted. Also used of the small hole one can peer through in an old-fashioned door lock.

examples.japanese: {鍵穴|かぎあな}に{鍵|かぎ}を{差|さ}し{込|こ}む。
examples.english: To insert the key into the keyhole.

examples.japanese: {鍵穴|かぎあな}が{壊|こわ}れていて{開|あ}かない。
examples.english: The keyhole is broken, so it won't open.

examples.japanese: {暗|くら}くて{鍵穴|かぎあな}が{見|み}えないので、スマホのライトで{照|て}らした。
examples.english: It was too dark to see the keyhole, so I lit it up with my phone's flashlight.

notes:
{鍵|かぎ} (key) + {穴|あな} (hole).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鍵穴|かぎあな}に{鍵|かぎ}を{差|さ}し{込|こ}む: to put the key in the keyhole
- {鍵穴|かぎあな}を{覗|のぞ}く: to peek through the keyhole
- {鍵穴|かぎあな}に{油|あぶら}を{差|さ}す: to oil the keyhole

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鍵|かぎ}: key; also 'lock' in everyday speech, as in {鍵|かぎ}をかける (to lock up)
- {錠|じょう}: lock — the mechanism itself, of which the {鍵穴|かぎあな} is one part
